page: Microsoft Azure E64ps_v7 is a high-density, memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Epsv7 series. Powered by the ARM64 processor architecture and hosted on Microsoft Hyper-V, the system provides 64 dedicated vCPUs. With 512.0 GB of total RAM, it maintains an allocation of 8.0 GB of memory per core. This high memory-to-core ratio designates the instance for operations where dataset residency in RAM is critical for execution performance.

Storage architecture on the E64ps_v7 relies entirely on external disk solutions, as the instance includes no local ephemeral storage. It supports Azure Premium Storage to deliver predictable input and output performance over remote connections. Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs provisioned on the machine. Networking and storage operations depend on remote fabrics, requiring architectural consideration for I/O path latency compared to instances configured with direct-attached NVMe drives.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture provides high memory density per compute unit. Eliminating integrated local disks and specialized accelerator silicon enables cost-effective resource utilization when workloads demand large RAM capacity without requiring high-cost GPU cores or local scratch space. Typical enterprise deployments for the E64ps_v7 include in-memory databases such as Redis or Memcached, transactional relational databases, large-scale caching engines, big data analytics, and memory-bound enterprise software suites.
description: Microsoft Azure E64ps_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine within the Epsv7 family, built on dedicated 64-core ARM64 processor architecture and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V. The instance provides 512.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio tailored for memory-intensive enterprise computing. It contains no onboard local storage, instead relying exclusively on network-attached Premium Storage for persistent data requirements. Acceleration hardware is omitted, with zero GPUs present, ensuring server resources are concentrated entirely on CPU and memory throughput. Operating on an energy-efficient ARM instruction set, the configuration presents a dense resource profile that optimizes infrastructure spending for scale-out memory tiers. Microsoft Azure E64ps_v7 is configured for workloads requiring massive memory footprints relative to compute capacity, such as large in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and batch data processing pipelines.
